additive_semantics: These rules add to V4 and V5; every V4/V5 field remains binding and no field is replaced.
validation_receipt_rule: validation_receipt.stage_metadata_hashes must exactly satisfy metadata_hash_map_schema and must be computed by the independent validator from the complete validated stage
pre_publish_rule: after accepting the validation receipt and immediately before atomic rename, supervisor reads and rehashes exactly the six staged metadata files once each; the resulting exact-key map must equal validation_receipt.stage_metadata_hashes byte-for-byte as canonical JSON
post_publish_rule: after atomic rename, supervisor reads and rehashes exactly the six final metadata files once each; attempt_terminal_pass.post_publish_metadata_hashes must satisfy metadata_hash_map_schema and equal validation_receipt.stage_metadata_hashes byte-for-byte as canonical JSON
mismatch_policy: SOURCE_PROJECTION_FAILED_ENGINEERING_NO_MARKET_VERDICT; publish forbidden before rename, terminal failure after any detected post-rename mismatch
